title: A focused launcher run is never credited as a passed check, though instructions name it as the way to run a focused test
outcome: An agent that follows the instructions for a focused test gets a check the host can credit, or the instructions say plainly which form is credited and which is diagnostic only.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md say, where they name the launcher's focused mode, that a check meant to satisfy a criterion bound to a test is run directly in the worktree and that a focused launcher run is recorded as unknown; or the launcher's focused summary carries the wrapped runner's passed and failed totals and the host credits it, with a test that shows a focused run of a passing cargo test recorded as passed.
The verification note the host writes for a check it recorded as unknown says unknown and why, not only the launcher's 'focused: passed' line; a test pins the text.
docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md and docs/test.md describe the chosen behaviour and agree with each other.
